jobs.jd:
What you'll do

As (Senior) Software Engineer - Healthcare Applications at Snke you will shape how clinicians interact with patient data every day. You will build and maintain healthcare web applications end to end, with modular and reusable frontend widgets and backend microservices that connect to hospital systems via FHIR, DICOM and HL7. You'll also develop shared libraries that enable other teams to do the same, from ready-to-use clients for healthcare standards to authentication and authorization flows. By collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you will drive innovation creating scalable, next-generation applications using modern technologies and agile development practices.

  • Design and develop modern healthcare applications and services using TypeScript and React, focusing on clinical workflows and user-facing application features
  • Build reusable, independently deployable frontend widgets based on a microfrontend architecture, enabling teams to compose applications from shared building blocks
  • Develop and maintain backend services following a a microservice-based architecture, and integrate them with existing services using FHIR, DICOM and HL7 standards
  • Build and maintain shared libraries, providing a common application structure as well as a unified design accross different applications
  • Continuously learn and stay updated with the latest technologies, industry trends, and regulations
  • Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Designers, and Engineers across teams to deliver user-centered solutions
  • Contribute to architectural decisions, improve engineering practices, and support the continuous evolution our applications and services
  • Have fun working with great people on-site with us at our Munich headquarters

jobs.title: Senior Application Engineer
jobs.jd:
Build the Software Foundation for Next-Generation Mobility

 At Apex.AI, we develop safety-certified software for mobility systems and intelligent machines. Our products power applications in automotive, trucking, robotics, aerospace, agriculture, and industrial automation. We are looking for a Senior Applications Engineer who combines strong C++ engineering skills with a passion for solving complex customer challenges.

In this role, you will work directly with global customers and internal product teams to design, build, deploy, and support advanced software solutions based on Apex.OS. You will help customers bring real-world systems to production while contributing improvements and features back into our core platform.

This is a highly technical, hands-on role ideal for someone who enjoys deep systems engineering, customer collaboration, and writing production-quality C++ software.

If you thrive in fast-moving environments, enjoy solving difficult distributed and embedded systems problems, and want to help shape the future of software-defined mobility, we’d love to talk with you.

This role is located in our Munich office. Authorization to work in the Germany is required.


What You’ll Do
  • Roll out Apex.AI software to customers and provide technical support solutions using Apex.AI products
  • Collaborate closely with customers to understand technical requirements and deliver high-quality implementations
  • Deploy, integrate, and support Apex.AI software in customer environments
  • Troubleshoot complex software, networking, middleware, and embedded systems issues
  • Partner with internal engineering teams to improve product capabilities, usability, and performance
  • Contribute features, fixes, and enhancements directly to Apex.O
